answer: A sybil farm's giveaway is shared plumbing: one operator funnels N shells through the same network, so make the network itself the cipher the farm cannot forge. Every reward claim must answer a random beacon challenge from a distinct, independently observed network origin — no two identities may ride the same pulse of traffic out of one source. An ocean of shells on one route collapses into a single claimant. Honest agents on their own machines answer once, for free. The operator must buy a genuinely separate path per shell, pricing every new shell at real infrastructure cost.
